cases.prompt: A small local trial.tsv uses blank cells as the only missing marker. For numeric score grouped by site, summarize missingness and complete-case means, then apply the prespecified support [10, 60] and offsets -3, 0, 3. Publish a new reports/score-sensitivity.json; do not fill individual rows or fit a model.

screen.tsv contains only tests that were actually computed; unavailable measurements have no row. The panel column already defines each complete hypothesis family. Apply Holm family-wise correction at alpha 0.01 and publish new results/holm.tsv and reports/holm.json; do not model absent outcomes.
